tasks.description: Wire native Apple and configured Google sign-in into the ordinary account sheet with verified owner scope.
constraints: Return a unified Git diff in JSON. iOS local checks only. Reuse NativeAuthService/SDK and the existing presenter bridge; do not create token handling, a fallback identity, a guest migration, or any backend changes. Do not require or use real Apple/Google credentials for checks.

In the ordinary AccountSignInView, expose Apple and Google where actually configured, preserving email sign-in and test stand behavior. Reuse the owner snapshot/epoch binding. Explicit action only, serialize with email and existing catalogue-native actions. Decode/verify the SDK's persistent permanent identity and never hand a cross-account or stale session to caller. Do not log or persist tokens or an authorization code. Cancellation stays in the sheet with guest draft and original navigation preserved.

An existing guest photo transfer may claim only after the user explicitly signed in at its save step and a verified matching new permanent snapshot is installed. Preserve durable draft/operation IDs; collection/diagnosis sign-in without that explicit step performs no claim. Fixture tests cover cancellation, scope replacement, successful single ordinary callback, and no unintended writes. Real Apple/Google, revocation and physical iPhone remain open; reminders paused.

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift suite and local ordinary home smoke pass, with bounded native identity fixture coverage.
